rendered:
The variant that retained the most capacity is NFA-A: it kept ≈80% capacity retention after 100 cycles at C/3[1], against ≈70%[2] for NFA 811[3] and ≈50%[4] for NFA-F[5].
Its composition is LiNi0.8Fe0.05Al0.15O2[6], so its aluminium content is 15%[7] and its iron content is containing 5,[8] (the first of the values listed for NFA-A, NFA 811[9] and NFA-F, in that order).
Table 1[10] gives the c lattice parameter for the Al-rich NFA row, which is the aluminium-rich variant NFA-A, as 14.2232(4)[11]. The table labels its rows Al-rich and Fe-rich rather than by variant name, so matching this row to NFA-A is an inference from its composition.
